sources.name: INCOIS ERDDAP
sources.organization: Indian National Centre for Ocean Information Services, MoES, Govt. of India
sources.notes: National in-situ data (e.g. Indian_ARGO_Floats tabledap — verified live). NOTE: gridded holdings are archival; server presents an incomplete TLS chain (provider sets verify=False). PFZ advisories are portal images/PDF, not machine-readable.

sources.name: NOAA CoastWatch/PFEL ERDDAP
sources.license: Public domain (work of the U.S. Government)
sources.notes: Verified live datasets: jplMURSST41 (SST 0.01°, current), nesdisVHNSQchlaDaily (chlorophyll 4 km), nesdisSSH1day (geostrophic currents, ~5 mo lag → flagged STALE).

sources.name: NOAA CoastWatch National ERDDAP
sources.license: Public domain (work of the U.S. Government)
sources.notes: Verified live: noaacwBLENDEDNRTcurrentsDaily (0.25° blended NRT ocean currents, u_current/v_current, current to within ~2 days).

sources.name: PacIOOS ERDDAP
sources.notes: Verified live datasets: ww3_global (waves 0.5°, hourly +7d forecast), ncep_global (winds 3-hourly), dhw_5km (CRW SST/anomaly).

sources.name: Open-Meteo (marine & weather forecast API)
sources.notes: Free non-commercial, no API key (verified live from Gulf of Mannar). Attribution to Open-Meteo/DWD required per their terms.

sources.name: Marine Regions (VLIZ maritime boundaries & gazetteer)
sources.notes: Maritime Boundaries geodatabase (EEZ 12/24/200 nm). Reference GIS geometry — NOT a legally definitive representation of the India–Sri Lanka IMBL.

sources.name: Protected Planet / WDPA
sources.notes: Marine protected areas. Polygons are reference GIS products; check WDPA terms.

sources.name: Bhashini (Dhruva) language AI services
sources.notes: ASR / NMT / TTS for Indian languages. Optional; disabled without credentials.
